Welcome to ACAR
The Adhiyamaan College of Agriculture and Research, Athimugam, Shoolagiri, Krishnagiri, was established in 2016 by AERI Trust (Adhiyamaan Educational & Research Institutions), Chennai, to provide quality education to the young community. The campus spreading over 122.5 acres, about 22 km from Hosur, the institute has a very picturesque and serene atmosphere surrounded by green hillocks.

Students Says
Overall I appreciate the efforts made by the institution to provide supportive learning environment.The Campus facilities, Academic resource and Staff have been helpful in many ways.The faculty members are knowledgeable, approachable and genuinely invested in student success.
Ms. T. Abinaya,
student
Being a student of Adhiyamaan college of agriculture and research made me realise that I’m in the right place, being destined to pick B.Sc.(Hons.) Agriculture. Initially I was eager to look at all the plants planted on our farm, which were categorised into Agronomy cafeteria, Horticulture cafeteria, medical plants garden and all other farms wide and more.
Mr. D. Elavarasan,
student
Our college has a spacious 123-acre campus with modern classrooms, well-equipped laboratories, and a vast library. Good hostel accommodations are also available for us. The college offers a four-year (Hons) Agriculture program, providing us with theoretical and practical knowledge in agriculture.  The faculty members are experienced and helpful, by providing guidance and support to us.
Mr. S. Dinesh,
student
In our college, we are blessed with excellent our faculty who have gained deep knowledge and experience in each course they handle. Their teaching methods make complex topics easy to understand. Our college provides outstanding practical training through well-maintained farms, labs, and field visits, which truly enhances our learning. Here, Strong emphasis on research and innovation, encouraging students to explore modern techniques in sustainable farming and agriculture.
Mr. S. Sakthivel,
student
We gained more practical knowledge than theory. Our faculty members are experienced and knowledgeable in their respective fields. In our college infrastructure such as classroom, laboratories, library are maintained and equipped well. Our library is stocked with relevant books, journals newspaper and online facilities. The college also organizes regular seminars, field visits, and workshops, which helped expose students to modern agricultural techniques and technologies.
Mr. R. Ganesh Kumar,
student
